narrative.coaching_note: The one change to make next time is to clean your hands for Moment 5 right after touching the patient zone at 5.8 seconds before you touch the healthcare area. At 0.5 seconds your bare hand touched bed rail A and picked up contamination, and at 3.4 seconds that same hand touched call button and at 6.6 seconds touched phone, so the contamination moved from the patient zone to those two surfaces. Later your gloved hand also touched bed rail A at 11.1 seconds and became contaminated. Next time, clean your hands before putting on gloves at 10.9 seconds and avoid touching phone at 19.3 seconds with gloved hands. That pause for hand hygiene keeps contamination from traveling with you when you move between zones.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with MRSA source bed rail A. Hand hygiene compliance 0/2 overall; Moment 5 0/2, Moments 1, 2, 4 0 opportunities. No hand hygiene events recorded. Contamination transfer: bed rail A to bare hand at 0.5 s, then bare hand to call button at 3.4 s and to phone at 6.6 s; bed rail A to gloved hand at 11.1 s. Missed Moment 5 at 5.8 s (bare hand) and at 18.7 s (gloved hand). Glove use issues noted: no hygiene before donning at 10.9 s and gloved contact with healthcare-area phone at 19.3 s. At end, bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, and phone remained contaminated. Surfaces to disinfect: bed rail A (source, 3 contaminated contacts), call button (2), phone (2) using an EPA List H registered disinfectant effective against MRSA.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was performing hand hygiene for Moment 5 at 5.8 seconds.
